Confirmed: movement is "blocked" — I'm stuck on the notice board tile.

Let me try interacting with the notice board one more way. The task mentions "read notices" as a KeyE action. Perhaps the notice board is read by pressing E while standing adjacent to it — but I'm ON it. Maybe I need to be at (2,6) or (2,8) to read it. But I can't get there.

Wait — let me reconsider. What if the notice board is actually at (2,7) but I'm at (2,7) and the game's "read notice" works when you press E and the notice is within range (including your own tile)? The E handler said "nothing-there: nothing at 1,7" — it's checking the front tile only.

Let me try pressing E while facing DOWN (2,8) — maybe the board is mounted on the south wall of my tile and read from below. Already tried, nothing.

I'm going to try one final creative approach: maybe the notice board can be read by pressing E when facing it, and "facing it" means the board is at my tile so I face any direction and it reads. But it doesn't.

Let me try pressing E and C simultaneously, or try the "read" via a different key. Let me check if there are other controls I'm missing.
